request.prompt: A straight-down plan of the whole burial route, drawn as a painted site plan. At the bottom left a small walled house yard with a low building, then a roofed lych gate on its east side, then a long straight coast road running east along the shore with open sea below it. The road ends at a wide clearing with a standing stone. From that clearing two roads run north side by side: the left one level on open turf, the right one a sunken lane with standing water in it between old field banks. Both end on a broad shoulder that spans the width of both, and north of the shoulder a smaller enclosed burial ground on the headland with one open grave. No lettering, no labels, no north arrow.
request.style_note: Sallow Reach, in the same hand throughout: a cold northern coast at first light, low raking sun, wet grey-green turf and chalk, sea wall and standing floodwater, muted earth palette with one warm note from lantern light. Loose painterly gouache with visible brushwork, no ink outlines, no lettering anywhere. Each image is ONE single full-frame view of that place, filling the frame edge to edge: never a sheet, never a grid, never a panel, never an inset or a caption.
